visual_identity.description: Protagonist Lý Phá Vân (Bạch Y Kiếm Tu): youthful yet profoundly disciplined Daoist swordsman embodying serene elegance, razor-sharp focus, and effortless agility in high-altitude mountain combat.
visual_identity.face_geometry: Clean refined jawline with sculpted cheekbones, calm almond-shaped eyes with deep dark irises, straight noble nose bridge, serene and composed facial expression without excess muscle tension.
visual_identity.body_proportions: Slender athletic martial build, approximately 178cm height, long limbs, upright spine with perfectly centered balance and erect posture.
visual_identity.hair: Lustrous ink-black straight hair reaching mid-back, upper section gathered into a high bun secured by an engraved sterling-silver crown hairpin (ngân quan), paired with dual flowing black silk ribbons cascading down the shoulder blades.
visual_identity.skin: Fair porcelain complexion with subtle cold-undertone radiance, immaculate texture reflecting diffuse dawn mist.
visual_identity.silhouette: Vertical, fluid, and wind-responsive; slender core accentuated by fitted waist and billowy lower robe layers creating a dynamic aerodynamic trail during footwork and leaps.
unique_traits: Serene unblinking gaze during sword engagements
Slight silver gleam in hair accessory under morning light
Zero extraneous head or torso bobbing during rapid linear lunges

baseline: Maintains defensive poise and observant distance before committing to attacks
Executes precision deflections using minimal angular rotation of the wrist and elbow
Glides across stone pavers with near-silent weight transfer and stable horizontal eyeline
Single decisive payoff thrust (X10) delivered without emotional flourish or theatrical hesitation
Restrained breathing and composed posture even after heavy kinetic clashes
forbidden: No wild screaming or theatrical battle roars
No uncontrolled wide slashing motions or over-extended swings
No modern military tactical stances or boxing guards
No anime-style exaggerated facial distortions or sweat drops
No demonic or corrupt energy manifestations

look_states.description: Pristine White Daoist Martial Robes (Bạch Y Đạo Bào) for high-mountain duel at dawn.
look_states.wardrobe: Multi-layered ceremonial martial vestment: inner white unbleached linen tunic, middle light azure-tinted silk cross-collar robe, outer flowing pure white heavy silk-crepe robe featuring delicate tone-on-tone silver cloud embroidery along lapels and sleeve borders; wide white silk waist sash bound by a dark silver plate and jade cord toggle; dark silver-grey embossed leather bracers tightly buckled over wrists; flexible black-soled white cloth combat boots.
look_states.hair: Neatly combed high crown bun with two black silk ribbon tails, stray sideburn wisps fluttering naturally in mountain breeze.
look_states.makeup: Subtle cinematic realism: matte natural skin, defined dark brows, natural lip tone, faint cold exposure blush on cheekbones.
accessories: Sterling silver cloud-motif crown hairpin (ngân quan)
Dual dark silver-chased leather forearm bracers (hộ oản)
Thanh Sương (Phá Vân Kiếm): 92cm slender double-edged straight sword with white mutton-fat jade hilt and silver cloud scabbard
condition: Clean, pristine fabric with mist moisture sheen
No blood, no tears; light wind-borne dust on hem only after X08 aerial landing
